nextGame.note: Friday night home game at Yulman Stadium. Memphis has won five of its six games.

news.headline: Tulane's last game is set for November 28
news.summary: The conference picked Saturday, November 28, for Tulane's trip to South Florida. The kickoff time and the TV channel will be announced about two weeks before the game.

news.headline: Army beats Tulane 20-17 on the last play
news.summary: Army kicked a field goal as time ran out at West Point on Saturday. Tulane had tied the game late on a 39-yard touchdown pass from Kadin Semonza to Jaylin Lucas, and hosts Memphis next Friday night.

news.headline: Jamauri McClure is back for the Army game
news.summary: McClure hurt his left foot in August and has not played all season. Tulane expects its best running back on the field Saturday at Army.

nextGame.note: Late morning kickoff in Austin against Texas.

news.headline: Vernell Brown III will miss the Texas game
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said Monday that the receiver is not expected to play Saturday at Texas. Sumrall said Brown is trying hard to get back on the field.

news.headline: Florida takes a star receiver away from Texas
news.summary: Easton Royal, a receiver at Brother Martin High School in New Orleans, switched his college choice from Texas to Florida on Sunday. He is rated one of the best high school receivers in the country and plans to play for the Gators.

news.headline: Florida drops out of the rankings
news.summary: Florida had been ranked 16th in the country, but Saturday's loss to South Carolina pushed the Gators out of the Associated Press top 25 on Sunday. It was their second bad loss in a row.

nextGame.note: Home game against Florida at eleven in the morning.

news.headline: Sarkisian defends Arch Manning
news.summary: Coach Steve Sarkisian said Monday that fans judge Manning harder because of his family name. He said if the name were off the jersey, people would be praising him.

news.headline: Texas loses a star receiver to Florida
news.summary: Easton Royal, a New Orleans high school receiver who had promised to come to Texas, switched to Florida on Sunday. The news came hours after the Longhorns lost to Oklahoma.

news.headline: Texas falls from first to seventh
news.summary: Texas was the number one team in the country until Oklahoma beat them 27-24 on Saturday. The new Associated Press poll puts Texas seventh and Georgia first.

nextGame.note: Sunday noon kickoff in New Jersey. The Giants have won three games, lost one and tied one.

news.headline: Minnesota beats the Saints 23-13
news.summary: The Saints gained only 142 yards in the Superdome on Sunday, and Tyler Shough threw two interceptions. New Orleans has now lost three home games in a row and is 1-4.

news.headline: Drew Brees is in the Ring of Honor
news.summary: The Saints put Drew Brees in their Ring of Honor at halftime on Sunday and gave him his Pro Football Hall of Fame ring. He is the ninth man the team has honored that way.

news.headline: Jonas Sanker runs a fumble back 87 yards
news.summary: Sanker scooped up a Minnesota fumble in the third quarter and ran 87 yards for a touchdown that tied the game at 13. It was the second longest fumble return in Saints history, and New Orleans did not score again after it.

nextGame.note: Tuesday evening match at Wheeling. Five o'clock our time, six o'clock theirs. Wheeling has won 12 games and lost 6.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher has her best day of the season
news.summary: Peyton had 8 kills in Friday's win over Millersville, more than anyone else on the team. It is the most she has had in a match this year, and she missed on only one of her 14 swings.

news.headline: Delaney Concannon wins a conference award
news.summary: The outside hitter had 27 digs in two road wins last weekend, including 16 against Gannon, more than anyone on either team. The conference named her its West Division defensive athlete of the week on Monday.

news.headline: IUP sweeps Gannon in Erie
news.summary: IUP won all three sets at Gannon on Saturday, 25-19, 25-12 and 25-19. Jessica Neiman led the team with 14 kills, and the Crimson Hawks are now 14-4.

news.headline: Tampa Bay beats the Yankees 4-3 and ends their season
news.summary: Tampa Bay won Wednesday night at Yankee Stadium to take the series three games to none. The Yankees are out of the playoffs, and it is 17 years since they last won the World Series.

news.headline: A fan reaches over the wall and takes away a home run
news.summary: Anthony Volpe hit a ball to left field in the sixth inning that would have tied the game at 4-4. A fan leaned over the wall and caught it, so the umpires gave Volpe a double instead and only one run scored.

news.headline: Aaron Judge says the Yankees should go all in
news.summary: Judge strained a calf in September and watched the whole playoff series from the dugout. He said afterward that the team should go all in and add players for next year.

nextGame.venue: Joe Yenni Stadium, East Jefferson High School
nextGame.note: Thursday night road game in Metairie, and a district game. Warren Easton has won two in a row.

news.headline: Warren Easton wins again, 29-6 over Higgins
news.summary: The Eagles beat L.W. Higgins on Thursday night at Pan American Stadium for their second win in a row. Their defense has given up only six points in those two games.

news.headline: Warren Easton wins its first game, 50-0
news.summary: The Eagles shut out Riverdale 50-0 on Thursday in Jefferson for their first win of the year. Warren Easton is now 1-4.

news.headline: Warren Easton loses at Zachary
news.summary: Zachary won 49-28 on Friday night. Warren Easton is 0-4 and plays at Riverdale on Thursday, October 1.
